text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! Suuummeeeerrr!! The party animal 
season is hereee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't we make a fuss over this 
exact same thing last year?

The bestie duo heads for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). This summer training camp is 
their runway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)... McQueen will 
naturally be running, of course. And 
besides her..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Though isn't this year gonna be 
even hotter? The vibes heading into autumn 
are crazy high☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this year will be packed 
with formidable contenders.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Ikuno!? Full of energy & 
motivation? Rocking those glasses as 
always☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I'm basically always wearing my 
glasses, except when I'm sleeping.

This Umamusume is Ikuno Dictus. A 
dependable secretary-type Umamusume who's 
also on good terms with Mejiro Palmer and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno, do you know anything about this 
year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have a few pieces of information.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First, Nature-san said she would 
participate. And then I will too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature and Ikuno☆ Then this Halloween 
party is basically just our inner circle♪

Nice Nature is an approachable, 
down-to-earth Umamusume. She's on great 
terms with Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku 
Helios, too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And Mejiro McQueen-san. And biggest of 
all...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It means Tokai Teio herself will be 
running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio... She's entering, McQueen's 
rival...

Tokai Teio. An Umamusume gifted with 
extraordinary star power, whose running 
style captivates all who watch.

With Tokai Teio entering the race 
alongside Mejiro McQueen, it seems they'll 
be the center of attention, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Bring it on, Teio! Bring it on, McQueen! 
Honestly, all of you can just come at me 
at once."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I— We're not scared! Right, bestie?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy-yo! Ain't no fear, ain't no tears! 
Vroom, vroom-vroo★m!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of Umamusume comes at 
me, who's the absolute brightest and 
strongest—!?

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text:
Here's to our friendship, whooooooa yeah! 
☆

Mejiro Palmer's face no longer clouds, 
even under the dazzling aura of star 
Umamusume. A pumped-up summer was about to 
begin.
